label: Speedometer
intent: The car accelerates and the speedometer reads it. Light: the needle sweeps up to the top mark, each mark it passes flares inward, it holds the reading a beat and drops back to its stop quicker than it rose. Strong: the car pulls through the gears: the needle climbs in three surges with a pause at each change, the marks flare in turn and the red-line mark flares hardest on arrival, then the needle drops back to its stop. The needle never overshoots its reading.

tick-0.//: each mark flares inward from its root on the dial

needle.rotate.//: marks at +20 (tick-0), +80 (tick-1), +140 (tick-2); each surge arrives dead on its value
